provenance.seed_note: per-seed rows are kept separate; a mean/spread over the three training seeds is a different quantity from the evaluation-sample confidence interval and the two are never combined

statistics.independence_caveat: SemanticKITTI is ONE physical stream: its blocks are segments of that stream, not independent streams, so its intervals understate between-stream variation. Occ3D's 150 blocks are 150 independent scenes.
statistics.uncertainty_covered: evaluation sample only; NOT training-seed spread
statistics.global_iou_rule: recomputed from summed TP/FP/FN per resample
